examples.original: [clean] Start by identifying the object type and its likely locations based on common usage or storage.
examples.control: [clean] Plant spring bulbs (tulips, daffodils, alliums) at three times their own depth during October or November.

examples.original: [clean] Always check the most probable locations first, such as sinks, countertops, cabinets, or drawers.
examples.control: [clean] Remove suckers from the base of grafted rose bushes as soon as they appear.

examples.original: [clean] Open containers (e.g., cabinets, drawers, fridges) before searching inside them.
examples.control: [clean] Ventilate the greenhouse so humid air does not encourage mould.

examples.original: [clean] Clean the object using a sinkbasin as soon as it is retrieved.
examples.control: [clean] Save seed only from plants so the next season starts out strong.
